description: The callback's state isn't compared with the live flow's
The loopback listener takes any request, an icon's too, as the browser's return
old: Takes(kind) == IF Bridge THEN kind = "form_ours" ELSE kind = "get"
new: Takes(kind) == IF Bridge THEN kind = "form_ours" ELSE kind \in {"get", "other"}

description: A bridged listener takes a form from any origin
old: Takes(kind) == IF Bridge THEN kind = "form_ours" ELSE kind = "get"
new: Takes(kind) == IF Bridge THEN kind \in {"form_ours", "form_foreign"} ELSE kind = "get"

description: A destroyed host leaves its login listening
old: /\ phase' = IF free THEN Gone(cur, phase) ELSE phase

description: A second login while one is under way starts another beside it
A second login ends the one under way and starts its own, which the engine ignores (startLogin before it reused the login)
old:
/\ ~SigningIn(cur)
    /\ LET k == next
       IN /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![k] = "open"]
new:
/\ LET k == next
       IN /\ phase' = [(IF live[cur] # 0 THEN Ended(live[cur]) ELSE phase) EXCEPT ![k] = "open"]

description: A login the browser never comes back to never expires
A host's end closes its sign-in without a notice
old: GoneIndicator(h) == IF SignsIn(h) THEN FALSE ELSE indicator

description: A new host starts a sign-in while an old one still signs in
The listener takes a return carrying any state, so a stray one ends the sign-in
An in-place reload that leaves the server alone ends its sign-in (the host swap before the in-place reload did)
The token exchange saves and reports the login before the check request, as fx did before the fix
A refused login is saved with the accepted ones
old: /\ saved' = IF a # "refuse" THEN saved \cup {k} ELSE saved

description: A refused login is reported as signed in
An accepted login isn't saved once the check request ends: the held save is lost
old: /\ saved' = IF a # "refuse" THEN saved \cup {k} ELSE saved

description: A check request that gets no answer in time never ends the sign-in (no timeout)

/\ phase[k] = "confirming" /\ alive[hostOf[k]]

new:
/\ phase[k] = "confirming" /\ alive[hostOf[k]] /\ ck[k].srv # "fail"
    /\ LET h == hostOf[k]

old: Gone(h, ph) == [k \in Logins |-> IF hostOf[k] = h /\ Pending(k) THEN
new: Gone(h, ph) == [k \in Logins |-> IF hostOf[k] = h /\ Open(k) THEN

description: A second login starts while the first one's check request runs
A re-read of the store takes a login in place of the one a sign-in holds
The branch for an unreadable store answers a sign-in's check request first and swallows a refusal
A logout leaves the login that waits for its check request going: the answer saves and reports it
old:
/\ phase' = Ended(live[cur])
            /\ live' = [live EXCEPT ![cur] = 0]
            /\ indicator' = FALSE
       ELSE UNCHANGED <<gone, phase, live, indicator>>
new:
/\ phase' = phase
            /\ live' = live
            /\ indicator' = indicator
       ELSE UNCHANGED <<gone, phase, live, indicator>>
